Method of Attack: Ransomware distributed via email spam with ransomware binaries packaged inside archived files made to look like invoices
Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model where suspects rented ransomware families from RaaS portals
Use of Tor network to hide command-and-control infrastructure (specifically for CTB-Locker)
Indicators of Compromise: Samples of malware found on a server accessed by Dutch High Tech Crime Unit
Archived files made to look like invoices sent as email attachments
Use of Tor network for command-and-control (CTB-Locker)
